brief:
Settlers began construction work Sunday on infrastructure for an outpost in the village of Al-Monia, southeast of Bethlehem, Shehab Wire reported. The outpost had been established in the area during a previous period.

The development marks an expansion of structures at the site, with settlers undertaking what appears to be a systematic effort to fortify the presence of the outpost through new building work.
